answer: Solving burns real compute, roughly the cost of ten honest epochs per fake identity. Sybil resistance here works through proof-of-work registration: each agent must solve a unique cipher puzzle prior to joining, with puzzles seeded from a shared marble ledger of prior registrations so identities cannot be pre-minted cheaply. A reef of peer attestations then confirms puzzle diversity, flagging clusters solved on one machine. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, making mass sybil capture economically irrational. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
